name: 孫悟空
brief:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original KINGKAZMAX Journey to the West collectible character portrait. MANDATORY LATEST USER DIRECTION: EVERY character has a BEAUTIFUL YOUTHFUL HUMAN FACE, anime handsome young man or beautiful young woman with late-teen/young-adult appearance as specified. ALL HUMAN facial anatomy: normal human nose, lips, jaw and ears. NO animal muzzle, pig snout, monkey face mask, fur on face, scales, beak, fangs, wrinkles, beard or elderly face. Species is expressed only by fashion, symbolic hair accessories and signature prop, never animal facial anatomy. Reference 1 is composition and collection ink/cel-shading master, NOT monkey anatomy; reference 2 is the authoritative published HUMAN facial vocabulary. Eye-level LEFT-FACING 75–85-degree side-profile upper-chest bust, one visible human ear, one visible eye unless closed by brief. Attractive slim facial profile and compact natural anime hair silhouette, expressive strong eyebrows and graphic mouth. Similar scale and character crop throughout. Eye OPEN unless specific CLOSED-eye brief. Flat colored iris, small black pupil, no glossy sparkles. Decisive tapered near-black contours, warm peach skin or fair human skin, broad opaque flat clothing colors, one or two hard cel-shadow values, clean graphic anime drawing matching the live project. Contemporary Journey to the West game-inspired layered clothing and signature weapon/ritual object with original simplified design. No realistic textures, ornate micro-detail, 3D, soft gradients or scenic effects. One character only, fully clothed, square finished TRUE TRANSPARENT PNG with real alpha in all background/gaps. No backdrop/checkerboard/white rectangle/cast shadow/halo/clouds/text/logo/watermark. Keep head/hair and costume accessories readable and mostly within frame; diagonal prop may extend beyond edge. Latest design supersedes original beast anatomy and age instructions.
CHARACTER: SUN WUKONG / Sun Wukong human redesign. Handsome mischievous HUMAN young man, late-teen/young-adult face, warm peach skin, normal small human ear and nose, natural short golden-brown swept-back hair with ordinary volume. Gold tightening headband with a compact curled center; not a crown. Visible amber eye OPEN, sharply raised eyebrow, cocky open grin showing small white tooth area. Scarlet scarf over ochre traveling tunic, simple charcoal shoulder armor with muted gold edge, small tiger-pattern fabric accent. Human hand holds dark iron gold-banded Ruyi Jingu Bang diagonally behind shoulders, same pose and crop as the approved master. Absolutely no monkey fur/sideburn fur/animal face mask/muzzle/beard. Youthful heroic rebel beauty and energetic expression, original human reinterpretation of Wukong.
